templates.name: Balanced homebrew spell
templates.description: A new spell of any level that sits beside the SRD spells of its level.

spec.balance: Match the damage dice, area, range and duration of SRD spells of the same level. A rider (a condition, a push) costs about one damage die. Concentration for anything that lasts.
spec.naming: Plain and evocative; no real-world names.
spec.instructions: Write the text fresh, never copied. Say who saves and what happens on a success.

templates.name: Cantrip
templates.description: A small at-will spell that grows at levels 5, 11 and 17.

spec.balance: One target, 1d10 damage at most (1d6 to 1d8 with a rider), or a small utility effect.
spec.instructions: Say what it does at character levels 5, 11 and 17.

templates.name: Ritual utility spell
templates.description: A spell that solves a problem outside combat and can be cast as a ritual.

spec.balance: No damage. Its value is time saved or a door opened; compare with Detect Magic, Comprehend Languages and Water Breathing.
spec.instructions: Mark it as a ritual. Say how long it lasts and what it cannot do.

spec.balance: Healing matches Cure Wounds and Healing Word for its level; a buff matches Bless or Aid. Concentration for buffs that last.
spec.instructions: Say who it can target and how it scales with a higher slot.

templates.name: Battlefield control spell
templates.description: Walls, zones and conditions that change a fight.

spec.balance: An area that hinders rather than kills: compare with Web, Entangle and Slow. Concentration always. A save each turn to end it.
spec.naming: Names that say what the ground does.
spec.instructions: Give the area size and shape and what a creature does to escape.

templates.name: Reaction spell
templates.description: A spell cast as a reaction to something that happens.

spec.balance: Compare with Shield, Feather Fall and Absorb Elements: small, immediate, once a round.
spec.instructions: State the trigger exactly ("which you take when ...").

templates.name: Summoning spell
templates.description: Calls a creature or spirit to fight or help.

spec.balance: Use the 2024 summon pattern: one stat block that scales with the slot level. Concentration, 1 hour.
spec.naming: Name the creature the spell calls.
spec.instructions: Give the stat block in short form (AC, HP by level, one or two attacks).

templates.name: Spell line spell (MANA)
templates.description: A spell for a MANA spell line, with its mana cost.

spec.balance: Balanced as an SRD spell of its level.
spec.mana: Cost in mana follows the world's mana rule; a cantrip costs none.
spec.instructions: Name the lines it belongs to.
